title: Webデザイン
subtitle: Web Design
keywords: Information design 2.Web Design 3.HTML/CSS 4.Intellectual property rights 5.Interaction Design
educationalGoal: In this Web design course, students will learn the concepts behind website construction, including information structure and effective navigation, as part of efforts to impart the knowledge necessary for designing easy-to-read and easy-to-use Web pages. In addition, the characteristics of multimedia material, the use of HTML and CSS, as well as techniques for making Web pages using a laptop computer, will be covered.
advice: Students are expected to acquire the knowledge and skills of webpage production based on the basic concepts of information design, understand the outline of the World Wide Web (WWW), and master fundamental website creation procedures such as planning, design, production, operation and management through practical training. To accomplish this, students will gain an understanding of the basic grammar of HTML and practice the use of CSS as a basic writing method for expressing Web pages. Students will also learn how to support various web browsers and web accessibility, and acquire the skills to offer information on web pages.
requiredKnowledge: Students are expected to be familiar with basic personal computer operations.

activityGoals.body: Be able to set up your own laptop PC and browse the World Wide Web.
Be able to write Web pages using text and multimedia in HTML by using a text editor.
Be able to upload the created HTML file to a Web server.
Be able to create a webpage layout using CSS.
Be able to create while taking into consideration effective information expression, information arrangement.
Be able to understand the concepts of personal information, security, copyright regulations, and netiquette.

lessons.content: Distribution of syllabus Course introduction Lecture: Chapter 1 “Approach to Web design” Practice: Chapter 1 "Set up a web development environments "
lessons.assignments: Read Chapter 1 of the lecture textbook and Chapter 1 of the practice textbook.  Install an editor to start web production and a browser to browse, and prepare the development environment (Chapter 1 in the practice textbook).

lessons.content: Practice: Chapter 3 "The basics of CSS (Class, Id, Layouts)"
lessons.assignments: Read Chapter 2 and 3 of the practice textbook.  Learn the basics of HTML and CSS grammar through practice. (Chapters 2 & 3 in the practice textbook).

lessons.content: Practice: Chapter 3 "The basics of CSS (Class, Id, Layouts)"
lessons.assignments: Learn about “Class" and “Id” of the website. And using these, make various web layouts through practice. (Chapters 3 in the practice textbook).  Create a web layout as a report and submit it by the fixed period.
Read Chapter 4 of the practice textbook.  Make the Fullscreen web site which has a header. (Chapters 4 in the practice textbook).

lessons.content: Lecture: Chapter 4 "Navigations" Practice: Chapter 5 "Making of 2 column layout (multiple column)"
lessons.assignments: Read Chapter 4 of the lecture textbook and Chapter 5 of the practice textbook.  Making the Fullscreen web site which has a header. (Chapters 5 in the practice textbook).

lessons.content: Practice: Chapter 5 "Making of 2 column layout (responsive)" Chapter 6 "Flexbox"
lessons.assignments: Read Chapter 6 of the practice textbook.  Make responsive layouts websites. (Chapters 5, 6 in the practice textbook).  Create a web layout gave from the class and submit it by the fixed period.
Read Chapter 7 of the practice textbook.  Make a website embedded other service, e.g. SNS. (Chapters 7 in the practice textbook).

lessons.content: Lecture: Chapter 5 "Effects of Motion and Sounds" Practice: CSS Animations
lessons.assignments: Read Chapter 7 of the lecture textbook.  Learn CSS animations to make a simple animation on websites .
Learn Javascript to make a simple animation on websites. (Chapters 5 in the lecture textbook)  Create an animation as a report and submit it by the fixed period.

lessons.content: Lecture: Chapter 6 "Surround Technologies" Chapter 7 "Testing and Running" Appendix "Intellectual property" Practice: Upload your web site
lessons.assignments: Read Chapter 6, 7 and appendix of the lecture textbook.  Understand digital literacy, and upload your website.

lessons.content: Lecture: Chapter 2 "Concepts" Chapter 3 "Structures" Practice: Hou to use a web design software.
lessons.assignments: Read Chapter 2 and 3 of the lecture textbook.  Learn how to make concepts for website. (Chapters 2,3 in the lecture textbook) And design a website using Adobe XD.

lessons.content: Final exam Practice: Creating your portfolio website (Design)
lessons.assignments: Be familiar with using Adobe XD.
Create your portfolio website.  Create an own web design sheet as a report and submit it by the fixed period.
Reflect on your own work while looking other works.
